text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Academy AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE ACADEMY MOD Defence Academy AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD Defence Academy (Shrivenham) — officer education, command & staff courses, cyber warfare curriculum, wargaming simulation, defence leadership, joint operations doctrine, and international military education. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Education Officer Education — Commissioning, Sandhurst Integration, Young Officer Training Initial officer education pipeline from Royal Military Academy Sandhurst. Young officer training at regimental duty. Continuation training through Phase 2 specialist courses. Professional development milestones — Captain, Major, Lt Col promotion gates. Leadership competency framework. Ethics and law of armed conflict embedded. Platoon, company, battalion command readiness. Joint service exposure modules. Staff College Advanced Command & Staff Course — ACSC, Intermediate Level Staff ACSC for Majors and Lt Cols — 12-month residential at Shrivenham. Operational planning and design. Campaign planning methodology. Joint fires and effects. Logistics and sustainment. Information advantage. Cultural awareness and human terrain. Strategic communications. Research dissertation requirement. DSACEUR/NATO staff preparation. Component command planning. Higher Command Higher Command & Staff Course — HCSC, Brigadier-Designate HCSC for selected Colonels and Brigadiers — 6-month course. Strategic-level decision making. National security policy formulation. Defence diplomacy and engagement. Resource allocation at scale. Crisis management at the highest level. Ministerial briefing skills. Multi-domain integration. Allied command preparation. Think-piece and policy paper requirements. Senior mentor engagement. Intermediate Intermediate Command & Staff Course — ICSC, Captain-to-Major ICSC for Captains and junior Majors — 9-month residential. Battalion-level staff work. Operational art fundamentals. Intelligence preparation of the battlefield. Logistics planning. Personnel management. Legal framework for operations. Joint fires coordination. Lessons learned integration. Exercise design and execution. Defence engagement at tactical level. Cyber Cyber Warfare Education — Cyber Cadre, Offensive/Defensive Cyber Cyber warfare specialist training pipeline. Offensive cyber operations education. Defensive cyber and network protection. Cyber threat intelligence analysis. Malware reverse engineering. Digital forensics. SCADA/ICS security. Cyber planning for joint operations. GCHQ/NCSC integration modules. CERT-Mil operations. Red team/blue team exercises. Accreditation against NCSC CyberFirst standards. Doctrine Joint Operations Doctrine — JDP Doctrine, Multi-Domain Integration Joint Doctrine Publication (JDP) education across land, maritime, air, cyber, space. Multi-domain integration concepts. Joint targeting cycle. Effects-based approach to operations. Mission command philosophy. Combined joint operations with NATO allies. Urban operations doctrine. Stability operations. Counter-insurgency (COIN). Information operations. Lessons from recent operations (Iraq, Afghanistan, Baltic). Leadership Defence Leadership — Command, Character, Resilience Defence Leadership Centre core programmes. Command leadership and ethics. Moral component of fighting power. Resilience and mental fitness. Diversity and inclusion. Command climate assessment. Coaching and mentoring. Transition leadership — military to civilian. Senior leader development. Cross-cultural leadership. Women in leadership pipeline. Veterans network. Wargaming Wargaming Simulation — Conflict Modelling, Decision Exercises Defence Wargaming Centre at Shrivenham. Campaign-level wargam
